briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid regulatory scrutiny

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models while governments accelerate oversight. Compute shortages persist as demand outstrips supply from TSMC and Samsung. DialectForge gains traction in secure multi-agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with 2.1T parameters achieving new SOTA on agentic tasks; xAI releases Grok-4 focused on real-time simulation; DeepSeek-V4 and Meta Llama-4-405B variants compete on efficiency. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus emphasizes constitutional AI updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with mandatory red-teaming for models over 10^25 FLOPs.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announces $15B expansion of Azure AI superclusters in Texas and Singapore; NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500K units monthly; Google TPU v6 pods now operational for internal Gemini training.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
